ev.q: evaluated the feasibility of SARS-CoV-2 variant detection in aircraft wastewater from incoming international flights
Aircraft Wastewater Surveillance for Early Detection of SARS-CoV-2 Variants
This investigation demonstrated the feasibility of aircraft wastewater surveillance as a low-resource approach
Aircraft wastewater samples were collected from selected flights from the United Kingdom, Netherlands, and France
arriving at John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York City

equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is used; groups are flight origin countries, which are geography.

notes: Laboratory steps (RT-PCR, sequencing, Freyja deconvolution, Pangolin assignment, genome-coverage QC) confirm or classify samples and are not procedures. Detected lineages are set beside GISAID Western European sequences (~90% BA.5) with no computed contrast. Design named as a feasibility evaluation of a surveillance approach.
